question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Thoroughly**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.
 
 
• **Thoroughly**: Completely; in a way that includes many details. (पूरी तरह; एक तरह से जिसमें कई विवरण शामिल हैं)
 
• **Through**: Expressing movement into one side and out of the other side of an opening, channel, or location. (एक उद्घाटन, चैनल, या स्थान के एक तरफ और दूसरी तरफ आंदोलन व्यक्त करना)
 
• **Holistically**: In a way, that deals with or treats the whole of something or someone and not just a part. (एक तरह से, जो किसी चीज या किसी व्यक्ति के साथ व्यवहार करता है या व्यवहार करता है, न कि केवल एक भाग के साथ)
 
• **Daily**: Done, produced, or occurring every day or every weekday. (हर दिन या हर सप्ताह किया, उत्पादित या घटित होता है)
 
 
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: However, listening abilities are one talent that has been significantly impacted.
 
• So, as per the meaning of the given words "**Thoroughly**" is the most appropriate option.
 
• "Thoroughly affected" means completely impacted. (पूरी तरह से प्रभावित)

Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.

Complete passage: *The modern-day student is extremely (1) savvy__ with technology. They do read quite a bit because of social media. While their writing skills may not be top-notch, they do write, courtesy __(2) their__ affinity to various platforms on the internet. However, one skill that has been **__(3) thoroughly __**affected is listening skills. They are extremely poor (4)_______ listeners. If this issue is not addressed, what we may be heading to in the future is a huge chunk of people across the globe, with poor skills of listening, and a huge number of passive listeners. Researchers say that listening is the prime ingredient for empathy and the world will be in extreme poverty in terms of the number of (5)_____ on the planet.*

45:T103d,

The correct answer is: **Active**
